topic: What time does the last Tube leave Brixton on a Saturday night?

text: Anyone know what time the last tube leaves brixton on a sat night? For the gig 🎶
No idea tbh. I'd have guessed sometime after midnight but don't quote me
I'm on the line saturday so I'll prob get a cab home anyway. Might not make it till 9ish
I think the victoria line runs late on saturdays but I genuinely don't know the time 🙈
Has anyone actually checked or are we just guessing
Not yet. Will look later, I'm up for ages anyway lol
Ok so a dog ate a whole bag of raisins this morning 😬 owner is fine, dog is on a drip for now. Long one
Sorry that was a lot, just needed to tell someone who isn't at work lol
Just woke up. Dog ok?
She's stable, they're keeping her in overnight to be safe. Owner was in bits
She's a lab 🙃 they always eat everything
Glad she's ok. Did anyone check the tube thing
Just up. Checked nothing, was at prep till 1am on monday. Who's actually coming to the gig
@claude what time does the last Victoria line train leave Brixton on a Saturday night

There isn't really a last Victoria line train from Brixton on a Saturday. The Night Tube runs all night on Saturdays, with trains roughly every 10 minutes according to a third-party timetable site (lasttrip.uk). I couldn't confirm a Saturday-specific time, and engineering works can change service, so check TfL on the day. Source: https://www.TfL.gov.uk/cdn/static/cms/documents/fandl-vic-wtt-42.pdf
